title: Twenty Years of Pandoc
summary: John MacFarlane reflects on two decades of Pandoc, the Haskell-based universal document converter that has become essential for converting between markup formats like Markdown, LaTeX, HTML, and DOCX, celebrating its evolution from a personal project to a widely-adopted open-source tool.
problem_solved: Provides universal document format conversion across dozens of markup languages and document types
why_valuable: Pandoc solves the pervasive problem of document format incompatibility, serving as a free, open-source 'swiss army knife' for writers, academics, and developers who need to work across different document ecosystems
